concept.title: Young children and their families
concept.shortdesc: Babies, toddlers and pre-school children, and families with children.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Children below school age, often with their parents, and the early years settings that serve them.
: Babies and toddlers, typically from birth to around five years, as the people the activity is for.
: Families with children or young people up to the late teens, including young families, as a whole household audience.
